title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons: Repair, Guarantee and Cash Settlement Figures by Rider
content:
The Optional Coverage Add-Ons publish, for each rider, the figures that bear on how a covered failure is handled: a repair-to-replace threshold rate, a parts lead time in days, a repair guarantee period, the cash-in-lieu offer validity and payment periods, and whether failures from unknown pre-existing conditions are covered.

## Figures by rider

| Rider | Repair-to-replace threshold rate | Parts lead time (calendar days) | Repair guarantee (calendar days) | Cash-in-lieu offer validity (calendar days) | Cash-in-lieu payment (calendar days) | Unknown pre-existing conditions covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider | 0.60 | 14 | 30 | 30 | 10 | No |
| Bridgewell Septic System Rider | 0.60 | 14 | 30 | 30 | 10 | No |
| Bridgewell Well Pump Rider | 0.60 | 14 | 30 | 30 | 10 | No |
| Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider | 0.60 | 14 | 30 | 30 | 10 | No |
| Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider | 0.60 | 14 | 30 | 30 | 10 | No |
| Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider | 0.60 | 14 | 30 | 30 | 10 | No |
| Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider | 0.60 | 14 | 30 | 30 | 10 | No |

## Definitions as published

- **Repair-to-replace threshold rate**: the repair estimate as a fraction of the contracted replacement cost at or above which Bridgewell replaces; 0.60 is 60 percent.
- **Parts lead time**: the calendar days of parts lead time beyond which Bridgewell replaces instead of waiting.
- **Repair guarantee**: the calendar days after a completed rider repair during which a recall carries no fee.
- **Cash-in-lieu offer validity**: the calendar days after a cash-in-lieu offer within which it may be accepted.
- **Cash-in-lieu payment**: the calendar days after acceptance within which cash in lieu is paid.
- **Unknown pre-existing conditions covered**: whether rider failures from unknown pre-existing conditions are covered.

## Points of reference

**Do these figures differ between riders?** No. All seven riders publish the same values: 0.60, 14 days, 30 days, 30 days, 10 days, and no cover for unknown pre-existing conditions.

**Illustration of the threshold rate (hypothetical figures).** For a component with a hypothetical contracted replacement cost of USD 1,000.00, 0.60 of that cost is USD 600.00; a hypothetical repair estimate of USD 600.00 is at that fraction, and one of USD 599.99 is below it.
